# MailerLite

MailerLite is an email marketing service that offers tools for creating and managing email campaigns, automating workflows, and building landing pages.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/mailerlite/.

## Actions

- **Create E-commerce Shop**: Connect a new e-commerce shop.
- **Create Field**: Create a new custom field.
- **Create Group**: Create a new subscriber group.
- **Create Segment**: Create a new subscriber segment.
- **Create Webhook**: Register a new webhook url for specified event types.
- **Create/Update E-commerce Customer**: Create or update a customer record for a shop.
- **Delete Automation**: Delete an automation workflow by id.
- **Delete E-commerce Customer**: Delete a customer from an e-commerce shop by ids.
- **Delete E-commerce Shop**: Disconnect an e-commerce shop by id.
- **Delete Field**: Delete a custom field.
- **Delete Group**: Delete a subscriber group by id.
- **Delete Segment**: Delete a segment by id.
- **Delete Subscriber**: Delete a subscriber by id.
- **Delete Webhook**: Remove a webhook subscription by id.
- **Fetch Total E-commerce Customers Count**: Fetch total ecommerce customers count for a shop.
- **Get Account Info**: Retrieve basic mailerlite account details.
- **Get Account Stats**: Retrieve usage statistics and performance metrics for the account.
- **Get Automation**: Retrieve details of a specific automation by id.
- **Get Campaigns**: Retrieve a list of all campaigns.
- **Get E-commerce Customer**: Fetch details of a customer by shop and customer id.
- **Get E-commerce Customers**: List customers for a specific shop.
- **Get E-commerce Shop**: Fetch details of a specific e-commerce shop by id.
- **Get E-commerce Shops**: List all e-commerce shops connected to the account.
- **Get Fields**: Retrieve all custom fields defined in the account.
- **Get Group Subscribers**: List subscribers within a group by id.
- **Get Groups**: Retrieve all subscriber groups.
- **Get Segments**: Retrieve all segments in the account.
- **Get Subscribers**: Retrieve all subscribers.
- **Get Webhooks**: Retrieve all configured webhooks.
- **Set Double Opt-In**: Enable or disable double opt-in for new subscribers.
- **Update E-commerce Customer**: Update a customer's data for a shop by ids.
- **Update E-commerce Shop**: Update settings of a connected e-commerce shop by id.
- **Update Field**: Update the title of an existing custom field.
- **Update Group**: Update a group's name by id.
- **Update Segment**: Rename an existing segment by id.
- **Update Subscriber**: Update an existing subscriber's information by id.
- **Update Webhook**: Update an existing mailerlite webhook.
- **Create automation**: Create automation
